title: "Vim Mode: Cursor Always Visible Across Multiple Terminal Instances"
body:
**Bug Description**
Ok so the main issue is that when in vim mode the cursor always shows up. So if I have two or three claude codes running in the same terminal (i.e. tmux altho i just use kitty terminal's built in functionalitiy, it's very hard to tell which one is active. The ideal solution would be what happens if I have multiple neovims open in the same fashion - the cursor only shows in the active one.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: kitty
- Version: 1.0.7
- Feedback ID: b57f5d65-3313-4b47-b391-7125ce2fb948

**Errors**

author: joeldrotleff

top_comments.author: joeldrotleff
top_comments.body: So to say it more simply: When using Vim mode, Claude Code always shows the block cursor even when "inactive". It should work like other terminal-based apps (such as Neovim) - the cursor should only show in the active window.

top_comments.author: joeldrotleff
top_comments.body: See: Screenshot, note how there are two cursors showing up when there should only ever be one
